0.original: Wawlika has a message to share with you.

48.original: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, glad you're here! Zawpya told me he needs to speak with you.

49.original: As for why he didn't simply track you down himself, your guess is as good as mine...

50.original: At any rate, you'll find him over at Shaaloani Station. Safe travels!

51.original: Sorry, friend, but Zawpya didn't tell me why he asked for you. He should be at the station.

52.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Perfect timing. You see, I have a problem...

53.original: It's the Dawnblazer. I know she detonated in the line of duty, but try as I might, I can't get that armored angel out of my mind!

54.original: After she came up in conversation the other day, it relit a fire in me. One thing led to another, and I found myself stitching together a little something inspired by her design.

55.original: I know how crazy this must sound, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I'd really love for you to have this ensemble!

56.original: (And if it's not to your liking, maybe you could find a roundabout way of asking Nitowikwe what she thinks of it...?)

57.original: Just think about it, all right? Together, we can keep her memory alive. Through us, the Dawnblazer will ride on!
